parole.significato: A large, shallow, oval dish used for serving food.
parole.testo: From the Scots form of French assiette. Doublet of assiette.
From Scots blackaviced, blackavised, from black + euphonic -a- (perhaps after blackamoor) + French vis (“face”) + -ed.

parole.significato: A low-bred, presuming person; a mean, vulgar fellow, especially one that cannot be trusted with a lady.
parole.testo: Short for caddie, from Scots, from French cadet, from Occitan capdet (“chief, captain”), from Latin capitellum, diminutive of caput (“head”).
